dish: Koji Picante (jalapeño-infused mezcal, koji, grapefruit, falernum) and the tequila-based Ethiopian Night
address: B2F Osaka Ekimae Daiichi Building, Umeda, Kita-ku, Osaka, Japan
w: Six-seat basement cocktail counter under the Ekimae Daiichi Building run by Ryu Fujii (ex-Bar K); Osaka's first entry on Asia's 50 Best Bars, ranked No. 58 (2025) and No. 72 (2026).

dish: No-menu bespoke cocktails built on house infusions, bitters and liqueurs
address: Nishishinsaibashi (opposite Triangle Park, Amerikamura), Chuo-ku, Osaka, Japan
w: Hidden Amemura cocktail bar behind an Alice-in-Wonderland-sized door marked only by an occult symbol; Asia's 50 Best Bars No. 100 (2025) and No. 70 (2026).

dish: Blowtorched tuna cheek (aburi maguro hoho-niku), uni and ikura
w: Open-air standing seafood bar outside Kyōbashi Station run by Toyoji Chikumoto since 1992; his flamethrower-seared tuna went viral after Netflix's Street Food: Asia (Osaka, 2019). Four days a week, cash only, queue before 1pm.

address: Shin-Umeda Shokudōgai, Kakudachō, Kita-ku, Osaka, Japan
w: Standing takoyaki stall in the Shin-Umeda Shokudōgai warren under JR Osaka Station where locals queue for the negi-mayo balls; picked by Time Out and Inside Osaka.

dish: Kitsune udon (sweet fried tofu over chewy udon in Osaka kombu dashi)
w: Udon house founded in 1946 in the middle of the Dōtonbori strip — one of Osaka's most famous noodle specialists, serene inside, known for its dashi and kitsune udon.

dish: Competition-level micro-lot pour-overs and speciality blends
w: Coffee shop and roastery in Kyōmachibori led by World Barista Champion Boram Um; No. 24 on the 2026 World's 100 Best Coffee Shops — the only Osaka entry.
Kissaten founded by Sadao Ibuki in 1934 (Imaike), main store in Sennichimae since 1946 — an Osaka institution for dark-roast drip coffee whose regulars included Kasagi Shizuko and Shofukutei Shokaku.

dish: Okonomiyaki and Dōtonbori-yaki on the teppan
w: Flagship of the Osaka okonomiyaki house on the Dōtonbori strip — one of the city's most popular and English-friendly teppan counters; named by Lonely Planet and Inside Osaka.

dish: Udon-suki — udon simmered sukiyaki-style with seafood and vegetables in dashi
w: Noodle house with a 250-year lineage, famous as the home of udon-suki, Osaka's dashi-rich hotpot of udon, seafood and vegetables.

dish: Kobe beef teppanyaki steak grilled at the counter
n: Misono Kobe (元祖鉄板焼ステーキ みその)
w: Founded in Kobe in 1945 by Shigeji Fujioka — the restaurant that invented teppanyaki steak (first grilled for occupation-era American servicemen on a shipyard iron plate) and the counter-teppan format now copied worldwide.

dish: Omurice — the original ketchup-rice omelette, created here in 1925
w: Western-style restaurant founded 1922 where omurice was invented in 1925; the main shop occupies a former tea house with tatami rooms and a garden in Nishi-Shinsaibashi.
